_comment: Reviewed-but-not-now decisions for tools/check_dependency_freshness.py. A deferral is for a floor that would genuinely break something if raised right now, with the reason recorded here; it is not a place to park 'waiting for upstream to move first'. Each entry needs deferredLatest so it expires by itself once the registry moves past the release it was reviewed against; a permanent policy belongs on the declaring line as `# freshness-hold:` instead. A not-yet-verified major or dependency change may also be parked here, but the reason must name the verification that is missing.

@types/node.reason: major above the supported Node 22/24 runtimes (declared 24.10.1); types must match the runtime, so raising to 26.x would type APIs the runtime does not have. Cannot be raised until the supported runtime moves to Node 26.

typescript.reason: Trial on 2026-11-07 with every typescript pin at 7.0.2 (root, packages/cli, packages/package-loader-node, examples/*/packages/*): pnpm check fails with 4 x TS2305 in packages/package-loader-node/src/module-scope.ts(8,10..53) ("Module 'typescript' has no exported member 'transpileModule' / 'ModuleKind' / 'ScriptTarget' / 'JsxEmit'") and TS2882 in packages/studio/src/ui/main.ts(19,8) (side-effect import of '../style.css' has no type declarations). The TS2305 errors are real: typescript 7.0.2's only public entry point exports version and versionMajorMinor (node_modules/typescript/package.json exports '.' -> lib/version.cjs), the compiler API lives under the unstable/* subpaths, and package-loader-node transpiles project .ts/.tsx files at runtime with transpileModule. Re-review when typescript publishes a stable (non-unstable/) transpile API, or when the maintainer decides to give package-loader-node a different transpiler; only then add the CSS side-effect declaration for TS2882 and move every pin together.
